summary: Static/code-level verification of safe-area fix for Customer app (Expo RN 0.86). Pod has no node_modules/.env for Customer and backend cannot start, so runtime testing was not possible — this was expected per the review request. Verified both targeted components and all BottomSheet consumers for correctness and regressions. Fix is implemented correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomSheet (/app/Customer/src/components/customer/ux.tsx:225-243) PASS: uses useSafeAreaInsets, Modal has statusBarTranslucent + navigationBarTranslucent, footer gets paddingBottom: 12 + insets.bottom, no-footer path pads ScrollView content with 16 + insets.bottom, ScrollView uses flexShrink:1 so footer remains visible when content is tall (maxHeight 88%). Backdrop paddingTop: insets.top keeps sheet below status bar in edge-to-edge mode.

PaymentWebViewHost (/app/Customer/src/components/PaymentWebViewHost.tsx:134-156) PASS: Modal has both translucent props; outer View (testID='payment-safe-area') applies paddingTop: insets.top AND paddingBottom: insets.bottom; the gateway 'Confirming Payment' panel will now sit above Android nav/gesture bar.
SafeAreaProvider is mounted at root (/app/Customer/app/_layout.tsx:97) — insets propagate inside Modal children on Android with react-native-safe-area-context 5.7.0 + RN 0.86.3.

No regressions in other BottomSheet consumers (addresses, invoices share/email, RateCardBar, FormControls Select/DateSheet, DateRangePicker, OptionMenu, FilterSheet) — they inherit the bottom-inset fix as a bonus.

Minor nit (not blocking): subscriptions.tsx PlanSheet's inner ScrollView has an explicit maxHeight: 460 — combined with BottomSheet's own ScrollView this caps content height on tall phones; prefer removing the hard 460 and relying on sheet maxHeight (88%) to use the available area.
Minor nit: on devices with gesture navigation where insets.bottom==0 the fix is a no-op (expected). The baseline 12px paddingBottom keeps a nice tap target.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer app (/app/Customer) cannot be run in this pod (no node_modules, no .env, backend not startable). Only static review possible. For runtime verification of the safe-area fix, test on Android device/emulator with 3-button nav bar (where insets.bottom > 0). Verify: (1) subscriptions → Full-time Maid → 'Pay ₹X & Activate' button sits above nav bar, (2) Secure Payment WebView 'Confirming Payment' bottom panel visible above nav bar.
